verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents running its agent server locally, in Docker, on VMs, or under licensed Enterprise self-hosting, which lets users control where their data lives. However, nothing in the evidence describes region or residency selection for the managed OpenHands Cloud, or where conversation data is stored. Missing for 10: region/residency selection in OpenHands Cloud, documentation of where cloud data is stored, data-residency commitments or compliance statements, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run agents locally, in Docker, on VMs, or anywhere you can run an agent server backend
OpenHands Enterprise provides commercial capabilities and support for organizations that need licensed self-hosting or managed deployment options.
Free, local OpenHands for getting started
